tree.heading: Agency
tree.text: The term “agency” has the meaning given that term in section 3502 of title 44.

tree.heading: Director of OMB
tree.text: The term “Director of OMB” means the Director of the Office of Management and Budget.

tree.heading: Director of the Institute
tree.text: The term “Director of the Institute” means the Director of the National Institute of Standards and Technology.

tree.heading: Information system
tree.text: The term “information system” has the meaning given that term in section 3502 of title 44.

tree.heading: National security system
tree.text: The term “national security system” has the meaning given that term in section 3552(b)(6) of title 44.

tree.heading: Operational technology
tree.text: The term “operational technology” means hardware and software that detects or causes a change through the direct monitoring or control of physical devices, processes, and events in the enterprise.

tree.heading: Secretary
tree.text: The term “Secretary” means the Secretary of Homeland Security.

tree.heading: Security vulnerability
tree.text: The term “security vulnerability” has the meaning given that term in section 650 of title 6.

notes.text: References in TextThis Act, referred to in text, is Pub. L. 116–207, Dec. 4, 2020, 134 Stat. 1001, known as the Internet of Things Cybersecurity Improvement Act of 2020 and also as the IoT Cybersecurity Improvement Act of 2020, which enacted this section and sections 278g–3b to 278g–3e of this title and provisions set out as a note under this section. For complete classification of this Act to the Code, see Short Title of 2020 Amendment note set out under section 271 of this title and Tables.

Codification Section was enacted as part of the Internet of Things Cybersecurity Improvement Act of 2020, also known as the IoT Cybersecurity Improvement Act of 2020, and not as part of the National Institute of Standards and Technology Act which comprises this chapter.
Amendments2022—Par. (8). Pub. L. 117–263 substituted “section 650 of title 6” for “section 1501(17) of title 6”.

Sense of CongressPub.
